Module com.batallanaval
Package com.batallanaval.model

Class Player

java.lang.Object
com.batallanaval.model.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
HumanPlayer, MachinePlayer
public abstract class Player extends Object implements Serializable
A player in the game (human or machine). Holds their own board (where their fleet is placed, either the human's placement board or the machine's main board) and the history of shots they have fired at the opponent's board.
